description: Skelet AF-11 local raster adapter: optional PhotoCraft headless integration with confinement and deterministic errors

compatibility.instructions: Does the new raster adapter preserve existing contracts: provider egress/cost model (local/free-local), no-model gate (no fetch, no model hosts), pnpm workspace (packages/*), CI exact-head discipline (editor-adapters job now runs vector plus raster tests), and PhotoCraft pin 9713648 from UPSTREAMS.lock.yml? Is the only contract addition the new raster-adapter.ts plus raster tests and one CI step, with no change to REST/MCP/UI schemas?

correctness.instructions: Is the adapter logic factually correct: disabled unless enabled true with absolute executable plus confined root plus exact version pin; missing executable maps to unavailable; root confinement via resolve plus realpath with symlink escape refused; allowlisted convert/info/commands only with run/batch/droplet/mcp/serve refused as unsupported; convert args match the investigated upstream CLI (convert IN OUT --format FMT [--quality N] [--tiff-layers MODE], info FILE, commands); format/quality/tiff-layers validation is strict (format required, quality 1-100 only for jpeg/webp, tiff-layers only for tiff, output extension must match format, input extension allowlisted, input==output refused without overwrite:true); timeout/cancel/output-limit/malformed/failed classify deterministically; validateRasterBytes checks magic per format and inspectRaster reopens bytes?

evidence.instructions: Are the tests sufficient: 24 real process-level tests covering disabled-by-default, missing exe, valid opt-in png/jpeg-quality/tiff-layers plus info/commands, invalid configs, root confinement, traversal, symlink escape, unsupported ops, invalid formats/quality/tiff-layers/extension-mismatch, malformed output, timeout, nonzero exit, abort, output limits, authorization identities, raster magic validation, same-file guard, shell-metachar containment, env scrubbing, token-to-raster filesystem journey, exe symlink/dir refusal, no-model posture, unsafe-payload rejection, and direct execFile proof? Do lint/typecheck pass and does the updated CI job run both suites at exact head?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: execFile with bounded timeout plus SIGKILL, bounded maxBuffer/output bytes, cwd confined, no shell, no retries, no duplicate outputs, no clock/randomness in validate/inspect (pure magic checks plus sha256)? Does abort settle promptly and does timeout kill hanging children without orphans?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the AF-11 raster grain: PageDraw transplant, REST/MCP/UI wiring, donor vendoring, download/install, network, paid services, HEIF enablement, GPU/cloud paths, or unrelated refactors? Is the CI workflow addition (one raster test step) the only adjacent change, clearly required so the new tests are qualified at exact head?

security.instructions: Do boundaries hold: absolute-path-only executable (no PATH hijack), symlink exe refused, root traversal/symlink escapes refused with path-escape, shell metacharacters never reach a shell (execFile shell false plus strict format/quality/path validation, proven by metachar test with no marker file created), env scrubbed (only PATH/LANG/LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/TMPDIR/HOME, secrets dropped and proven by env-dump test), raster magic mismatch refused (text/JSON/script payloads fail as malformed-output, proven by malformed plus unsafe fixtures), input==output refused without explicit overwrite, anonymous invocations refused (actor/workspace required), diagnostics truncated, no ambient credentials, no TCP control, no HEIF/GPU/cloud enablement, no plugin loading?

state.change: AF-11 P14 local raster adapter: new packages/editor-adapters raster-adapter.ts with Skelet-owned PhotoCraft headless adapter (disabled-by-default, absolute-path pin, root confinement with symlink escape rejection, allowlisted convert/info/commands only, strict format/quality/tiff-layers validation with extension matching, safe execFile without shell, scrubbed env, bounded timeout/output, deterministic error contracts, magic-based raster validation/reopen), 24 real process-level tests with faithful fixture executables, plus editor-adapters CI raster step and index exports. No donor vendoring, no download/install, no network, no paid provider, no HEIF/GPU/cloud, no TCP control, no run/batch/droplet/mcp/serve.
